architecture_notes: The calculator application will have a modular architecture with distinct components for the user interface and core logic. The user interface will be developed using a modern front-end framework, while the core logic will be implemented in a separate module to ensure separation of concerns. Data flow will be managed through state management libraries to maintain consistency across the application.

tasks.title: Design Calculator Architecture
tasks.description: Create a detailed design document outlining the architecture of the calculator, including user interface design, data flow, and component interaction.

tasks.title: Implement User Interface
tasks.description: Develop the graphical user interface for the calculator, ensuring it matches the design document.

tasks.title: Implement Core Logic
tasks.description: Code the core logic of the calculator, including arithmetic operations and handling user input.

tasks.title: Test Calculator Functionality
tasks.description: Perform thorough testing of the calculator to ensure all arithmetic operations work correctly and the interface is responsive.

tasks.title: Handle Edge Cases
tasks.description: Add logic to handle edge cases, such as division by zero and invalid input.

tasks.title: Optimize Performance
tasks.description: Review and optimize the code to ensure it runs efficiently.

tasks.title: Final Testing
tasks.description: Conduct final testing to ensure the calculator meets all requirements and functions as expected.

tasks.title: Prepare for Deployment
tasks.description: Package the calculator application and prepare it for deployment.
